records.title: Public Policy and Law
records.header: PUBPOL 105 Public Policy and Law (5) SSc
records.text: PUBPOL 105 Public Policy and Law (5) SSc Introduces fundamental concepts of public policy and law and their roles in governance. Examines distinctions and intersections between legal and policy systems, foundational principles of the U.S. legal system, and frameworks for policy analysis. Explores applications of law and public policy across a range of contemporary policy areas.

records.text: PUBPOL 201 Introduction to Public Policy and Governance (5) SSc Provides an introduction to policy analysis, governance, and public service. Students learn how individuals organize for common purposes, and design, implement, analyze, and evaluate policy. Students examine how policy decisions emerge and how the values of public, nonprofit, and private sector leaders and institutions affect decisions and implementation.

records.title: Truth, Evidence, and Public Policy Analytics
records.header: PUBPOL 301 Truth, Evidence, and Public Policy Analytics (5) SSc, RSN
records.text: PUBPOL 301 Truth, Evidence, and Public Policy Analytics (5) SSc, RSN Sound public policy and governance decisions rely on having evidence to support conclusions, as well as having an understanding of the extent of certainty regarding the available evidence. Students will learn qualitative, statistical, experimental, and mixed methods to evaluate: the origins of policy; the management, implementation, and administration of public programs; and the intended and unintended impacts of public policies. Prerequisite: either QMETH 201, Q SCI 381, STAT 290, STAT 220, STAT 221/CSSS 221/SOC 221, or STAT 311; recommended: PUBPOL 201.

records.text: PUBPOL 313 Evidence-Based Policy Implementation (5) SSc Explores the multidimensional challenge of turning policy and program intentions into valued results on the ground. records.text: PUBPOL 321 Decision Making, Behavior, and Policy Design (5) SSc Provides a foundation in the application of decision theory and behavioral science to study public policy problems.
